This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="LF" /> [[Rott Mercer]] was a member of this species.<ref name="VG" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[human]]-like appearance, though they had extremely close-set [[eye]]s, and small bumps covering most of their heads.<ref name="LF" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Rott Mercer]],<ref name="VG" /> was a [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] convict who was present on the ''[[Palwick]]'', a [[prison]] [[transport]]. During an escape attempt, the convict managed to disable the [[pilot droid]]s who controlled the [[Starship|ship]], though they were but was re-arrested by the [[Jedi Order]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="LF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Lost / Found|first episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]],<ref name="LF" /> before being shown in better detail in previews for the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="VG" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]], who experimented with making them blue, though the more human-like appearance was later settled upon.<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20190121223617}}</ref>
